note: Frozen key of 30 tickets for scoring ticket-to-FSD-sentence matching (requirement-code, requirement-no-code, none); written by a fresh agent before anything it scores was built.

matching.right: A suggestion on a requirement-code or requirement-no-code ticket is right when one of the suggested requirement's FSD quotes and one of the ticket's listed quotes overlap: whitespace collapsed, case kept, one contains the other. So an atomic requirement cut from the right sentence counts, even if it's another clause of that sentence: this key can't tell clauses apart.
matching.suggestionsRight: Right suggestions / all suggestions, across all 30 tickets; a suggestion on a none ticket is wrong. Bar: at least 90%. No suggestions at all fails this bar.
matching.none: A none ticket scores when it ends with no suggestion and its run didn't fail. Bar: at least 8 of 10.
matching.found: A requirement ticket scores when it ends with a right suggestion. Bar: at least 14 of 20.
matching.failedRun: A ticket whose run failed has no suggestion and doesn't score: it counts against 'none' or 'found', and is reported apart.
matching.outcome: If suggestionsRight or none fails, matching ships off and requirements stay context. If only found fails, it ships on and the report says so (D99). Bars are not moved after a run.
matching.approval: Scored with approval skipped (the benchmark setting, D99), and the result says so.
